en.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Officially Announced for Fall 2026 Release
en.summary: Get ready to dive back into Night City. The electrifying anime series **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners** is officially returning with a new expansion for the game, targeting a Fall 2026 launch.
en.body:
The neon-drenched streets of Night City are about to get a lot more crowded. Netflix, in collaboration with CD Projekt Red, has officially announced **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2**, a new expansion set to launch in Fall 2026. This highly anticipated follow-up promises to bring more of the electrifying narrative and characters that captivated audiences worldwide.

The original **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners** anime, which premiered on September 13, 2022, was a critical and commercial success, earning a perfect 10/10 rating and dominating streaming charts. Its standalone sequel, **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2**, was initially slated for a 2026 release, and this expansion directly ties into that narrative, offering players a chance to experience Night City on a deeper level.

## Night City Expands Its Reach

This isn't just a digital expansion; it's a full-fledged return for the beloved franchise. The **Wuthering Waves x Cyberpunk: Edgerunners** DLC is already live, adding fan-favorite characters like **Lucy** and **Rebecca**, along with iconic Night City locales and even a free 5-star character. This collaboration serves as a tantalizing appetizer for what's to come in **Edgerunners 2**.

CD Projekt Red has confirmed that more details regarding the **Edgerunners 2 Update** will be unveiled on October 21, 2026, during a special episode of their **REDstreams** broadcast. This event will likely detail the full scope of the update, including new items and features that will be integrated into **Cyberpunk 2077**. The free update is scheduled to launch across PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X and S, with a release for the Nintendo Switch 2 to follow shortly thereafter.

## What This Means for Edgerunners Fans

For fans of the **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners** anime and **Cyberpunk 2077**, this announcement is a massive win. The success of the anime proved the immense potential of expanding the **Cyberpunk** universe through different mediums. This new expansion offers a tangible way for players to engage with the characters and world they've grown to love, bridging the gap between the animated series and the game. The promise of new content, characters, and potentially story elements directly inspired by the anime series has ignited excitement across the gaming community, eager to carve their own paths through the dark future once more.

## What's Next

Mark your calendars for Fall 2026. The **Edgerunners 2 Update** arrives on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S, with the Nintendo Switch 2 version to follow. Keep an eye on **REDstreams** on October 21, 2026, for the full reveal.

content_raw: After returning with a new season less than a week ago, Netflix 's 10/10 sci-fi series is trending on U.S. charts, where it immediately claimed the No. 1 spot upon its highly anticipated return. Connected to CD Projekt Red 's popular 2020 action RPG Cyberpunk 2077 , Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is the electrifying animated series everyone is obsessed with. It premiered on Netflix on September 13, 2022, to critical and audience acclaim, while its standalone sequel, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 , arrived four years later, on October 20, 2026 .
